item.title: How are CFOs impacting on-field performance in the football landscape?
item.description: Transfer fees for players are no longer assessed in terms of talent or tactical fit but modelled across contract length, amortisation profiles, wage structures and future resale value.

item.title: ACCA urges FCA to prepare companies for tougher sustainability reporting
item.description: The Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) has called on the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) to ensure UK companies are equipped to meet increasingly demanding sustainability reporting requirements.

item.title: Hainan endorses CGMA in new finance talent drive, AICPA says
item.description: The CGMA designation has been officially recognised as meeting the requirements of Hainan’s new high-level finance talent programme.

item.title: FRC outlines measures to make SME audits more proportionate
item.description: The Financial Reporting Council (FRC) has set out a package of measures intended to make audits more “proportionate” and more “efficient” for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

item.title: UK’s FRC sets out priorities in 2026–27 budget
item.description: FRC has issued its Plan and Budget for 2026–27, outlining priorities to “uphold high standards” in audit, corporate reporting and governance.

item.title: Bruce Cartwright to chair Audit Scotland from October 2026
item.description: Bruce Cartwright, the ICAS chief executive, has been named as the next chair of Audit Scotland. He became CEO of ICAS in March 2018.

item.title: Taiwan small businesses expect stronger growth in 2026, finds survey
item.description: More than half of Taiwan’s small businesses reported growth in 2025 and sentiment for 2026 has improved to its strongest level since before the pandemic, according to a CPA Australia survey.

item.title: UK’s FRC releases guidance on using AI tools for audits
item.description: The Financial Reporting Council (FRC) in the UK has released a detailed guidance for audit firms on the use of generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) in audit work.

item.title: FASB appoints four new members to investor advisory committee
item.description: The Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) in the US has expanded its Investor Advisory Committee (IAC) with four new appointments.

item.title: SCCCI, ISCA partner to strengthen China–Singapore professional links
item.description: The Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA) has partnered with Singapore Chinese Chamber of Commerce & Industry (SCCCI) to bolster commercial and professional communication between China and Singapore.

item.title: IFAC enhances global accountability with revised membership obligations
item.description: The International Federation of Accountants (IFAC) has unveiled a revised set of Statements of Membership Obligations (SMOs) 1–7, which came into force on 1 April 2026.

item.title: CA ANZ, ACCA publish case study on sustainability assurance judgement
item.description: Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand (CA ANZ) and Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) have issued a report to guide assurance practitioners on applying professional judgement to estimates and forward-looking information in sustainability engagements.

item.title: UK’s FRC overhauls PIE auditor registration rules
item.description: The UK’s Financial Reporting Council (FRC) has updated its Public Interest Entity (PIE) Auditor Registration Regulations and related guidance governing the PIE Auditor Register (PAR).
